final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ov, o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(*) AS c FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.timespan), s2 AS (SELECT ts, SUM(c) AS sc FROM s1 GROUP BY ts), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(sc) AS tot FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.ts AS ts, s2.sc AS sc, (s2.sc * 1.0) / s3.tot AS share FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.tot IS NOT NULL AND s3.tot <> 0), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s4) SELECT s4.ts, s4.sc, s4.share, s4.share - s5.av AS diff FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.av IS NOT NULL
